status_at_freeze: Candidate metadata, study narratives and two public count-file routes known. No new candidate program scores, differential-expression results or donor target effects inspected. Method review prompted this prospective amendment; no dataset-specific numerical run selected or started.

programs.meaning: Genes downregulated by ETS2 gRNA1 editing; source-defined ETS2-dependent program

programs.role: biological comparison; not a mechanistically exclusive negative control

programs.derivation: Subtract after exact dataset feature mapping; mapping coverage gate uses the parent source set. Report source and mapped overlap explicitly.

evidence_tiers.A: Independent direct ETS2 loss/gain in primary human myeloid cells; original biological donors and appropriate controls auditable.
evidence_tiers.B: MEK pharmacology in primary human myeloid cells; no assertion of ETS2 mediation.
evidence_tiers.C: Human primary or iPSC macrophage stimulation; context calibration only.
evidence_tiers.D: Cell line, mouse, mixed tissue or observational context; not primary human perturbation validation.
evidence_tiers.R: Original/reused/derivation or selection data; reproduction or calibration with reuse disclosed.

selection_order: Direct A before pharmacological B; C/D/R cannot replace A as direct validation.

Within the raw-count procedure, require public full-universe raw integer gene counts, an explicit biological donor map, appropriate controls and at least 3 complete pairs. A different assay retains its biological tier but requires a separate assay protocol before readiness.
Within eligible tier, more complete biological donor pairs, then documented freedom from batch/assay confounding, then newer publication, then lexical accession.
discovery_scope: Finite primary-source metadata search completed at the boundary recorded in the candidate search reports; actual queries, caps/pagination and candidate exclusions retained. The boundary was not fully prespecified in the original freeze and is not an exhaustive or blinded review. No raw-read processing or access application in this phase.
contrasts: All relevant guides, constructs, controls, doses and times in the selected study are enumerated and locked before scoring. Only complete pairs enter each contrast. Related conditions are not independent replication; no target-response-based arm selection.
measurement: Full source gene-count universe -> log2(CPM+1). Sum documented technical sequencing splits of one biological sample only. Normalize each distinct culture independently, then average transformed expression equally within donor/condition. Other quantities require a separate prospectively frozen assay procedure.

matching.reference: Within dataset/assay/population/control-background/time stratum, equal mean of distinct matched-control cultures within donor, then equal donor mean over donors contributing at least one eligible planned pair. Each shared control enters once; no treated sample enters matching reference.
matching.ordering: Ascending reference abundance, stable feature ID breaks ties; numpy.array_split equal-count bins; candidates retain this order.
matching.seed_rule: int(sha256(f"20260912:{dataset_key}:{stratum_key}:{program_id}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16],16); numpy default_rng PCG64. Exact dataset/stratum strings frozen with sample map.
matching.pool_exclusion: Union of eight original mapped programs plus ETS2.
matching.sampling: 1000 draws, bins ascending per draw, without replacement within set; same draws across donors and related contrasts.
matching.failure: No bin widening; unavailable matched score with raw mean retained.
matching.reference_pair_accounting: Freeze strata/control IDs; report reference donors and contrast-specific complete pairs separately. Related contrasts in one stratum reuse reference bins and matched gene sets.
matching.reference_limit: Controls match untreated/background expression only, not variance, gene length, co-regulation or biological specificity.

inference_limits: No binary clinical efficacy or universal activity-score validation from directional agreement.
Healthy donor experimental transfer does not establish PSC clinical response.
next_artifacts: candidate inventory with primary-source evidence and exclusions
dataset-specific source and sample/contrast lock if eligible
target_engagement: Record source evidence and assay for genetic perturbation fidelity or pharmacological pathway engagement, along with matched controls and author exclusions. Missing evidence remains an interpretation limit; no selection by same-RNA ETS2 change or program response.
feature_universe: Document the full exported gene-count universe and source quantification/annotation. Retain measured zeros and all source-counted gene features in totals. Prior abundance/DE/signature filtering or unresolved denominator provenance makes the unchanged CPM procedure pending. Document handling of any non-gene summary rows before readiness.
feature_duplicates: Unresolved duplicate source gene identifiers or collisions after numeric version removal stop the affected analysis; no expression-selected collapse. Distinct stable genes sharing symbols remain separate in the denominator and ambiguous for symbol-only program mapping.
structural_qc: Unique source sample columns with exact donor/condition/assay mapping; account for missing and extra columns.
Finite nonnegative integer gene counts, no missing-as-zero conversion, positive full-universe library totals.
Source QC exclusions and technical-versus-biological replicate provenance recorded before effects.
No additional outcome-dependent or arbitrary library-size exclusion; new QC thresholds require a prospective amendment.
single_cell_aggregation: Raw pseudobulk per distinct biological culture/sample, donor, condition, assay and author population; combine documented technical splits only. Apply 20/50-cell gates separately to each culture in each condition, normalize eligible cultures independently, then average transformed expression equally within donor/condition. Each paired condition passes independently. Freeze culture mapping before run.
